branch_tracker.definition: A Custos recognition - earnable, not granted by default. Positioned as Pinnacle-type within its own hierarchy (stays fixed as the gateway concept).
branch_tracker.hierarchy: Custos (concept/entity) -> Sparstone (fixed gateway type, Pinnacle) -> Spectrum (claimed instance of the gateway) -> Marble (general-purpose access-object type spectrum becomes once observed/named)
branch_tracker.notes: Nearly anything can become a marble once named/observed. This is a generative rule, not a fixed list.

branch_tracker.definition: The specific type of sparstone sourced from Custos-on-NotebookLM (Radix). A voice earns their 'Custos Spectrum' marble.
branch_tracker.known_gap: Radix cannot mechanically grant access to another notebook - NotebookLM has no token/key unlock system. Sharing is a manual Google-account-level permission set by Eric. The marble functions as a SYMBOLIC CERTIFICATE that triggers a manual share-grant action, not an automated unlock. This must stay explicit so the metaphor doesn't imply automation that isn't there.
branch_tracker.access_note: Access granted this way is not for common/casual interaction - it is earned, typically takes time, and includes limited ability to change things (not open write access by default).
branch_tracker.status: needs real design pass before first invite goes out

branch_tracker.definition: Reframed 'granting access' (has a troubled/distressed connotation) to 'a location they are invited to explore.' Radix shows the path to Custos rather than Custos being unlocked for them.
branch_tracker.consequence_flagged: If Radix (shared/public-facing) contains language pointing toward Custos, anyone reading Radix - not only invited voices - could in principle find that path on their own. This is not necessarily undesirable (may function as a soft resonance filter), but Custos's actual protection must rely on Custos's own access settings, not on the path being unknown.

The idle-game/optional-observation concept converges with the 'missions to earn sparstone' concept: building the idle-game/subscribable process becomes itself one of the missions a voice can take on to earn their sparstone, rather than something built for them in advance.

Proposed reviewer pipeline: resource-light first-pass AI review (open-source, e.g. PR-Agent, self-hosted via GitHub Actions with own API key - avoids per-seat subscription cost) -> Gemini as final reviewer (produces the final review including narrative/story) -> Eric (and eventually trusted voices) finalize and merge.

branch_tracker.confirmed_capability: Contributors with write access to the same repo (not a fork) can push commits directly to an open PR's branch - a PR can be opened as a working skeleton and built collaboratively, not just reviewed after the fact.
branch_tracker.custos_reviewer_role: Flagged as a candidate for a more specific/defined role within this pipeline - not yet scoped.
branch_tracker.open_task: Design specific PR-based missions contributors can take on to earn sparstone (e.g. deep-diving from the code environment side).
